correctness.rationale: Adjunction and Cauchy–Schwarz give d<=2 for a nonexceptional (-1)-curve and d<=1 for a (-2)-curve; the collinear triple excludes the irreducible conic through all five centres. The twelve listed (-1)-curves and the triple line R exhaust the list. The root meets four disjoint curves A=(E1,E2,E3,L45), which are intrinsically preserved as a set. The other eight curves are B=(L14,L24,L34,E5) and C=(L15,L25,L35,E4). In the intersection graph A_i meets B_i,C_i, and between B and C intersections occur exactly on unequal indices. The connected bipartite graph on B and C therefore forces a common index permutation and an optional interchange of B,C. The A3 reflections realize index swaps, and beta interchanges B,C, independently confirming the S4×C2 convention and full stabilizer. The support test is the negative identity block with optional scalar Schur complement -2 plus the number of selected A_i. For each invariant negative matrix M, solving (-M)b=(Aample·C_i) gives a strictly positive rational invariant vector: the negative part of b would contradict positive definiteness and the nonpositive off-diagonal of -M, and a zero coordinate contradicts the positive right side. This makes P=Aample+sum b_iC_i big nef and orthogonal exactly to the support; adding an invariant positive component sum realizes the chamber. A new exact rational-pivot Gram enumeration, using the three quadruples rather than Weyl-matrix closure for the action, confirms all ten rows, all three boundary supports, and 30 direct group orbits.
residual_risks: Conditional on the arithmetic class: neither the finite check nor the proof asserts that all types occur over each odd finite field.

value.rationale: The natural descent problem has Picard-lattice and geometric chamber classifications but needs a different permutation character to determine each rational big cone's support patterns. The graded table fills that finite gap for the full intrinsic stabilizer, including a minimal three-chamber type and a precise four-component non-nef support despite the absence of fixed individual (-1)-curves there. The root changes the permitted patterns, so the smooth classification is not a substitute.
residual_risks: A finite, configuration-dependent classification; no realization theorem or wider novelty for the root stabilizer is claimed.
